subject: Request: temporary rate-cap remediation & staggered burst window for EdgeAI rollout
content:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@edgeai.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: platform@edgeai.com
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production rollout — burst behavior & rate cap guidance

Hi Marcus,

Quick note from our production rollout this morning: during the first 90 minutes we observed three short spikes where API responses hit the 120 RPM rate cap and returned 429s. The traffic pattern is highly bursty because the customer side schedules batch inference when new telemetry arrives.

Our security/compliance team is asking whether Redwood can provide a short-term remediation while we implement request smoothing on our side. Specifically they asked for either: a) a temporary increase to the burst allowance for the rollout window, or b) a guaranteed prioritized window (10:00–12:00 PT) where EdgeAI traffic won't be deprioritized by fairness policies.

We understand production SLAs are tied to rate limits and fairness; we want to avoid throttling impacting customer SLAs. Can we get a path forward and any required paperwork? I attached our traffic sample and the SLA matrix we reference.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee\Platform Engineering — EdgeAI
attachments: edgeai_sla_matrix.xlsx, redwood_traffic_sample.log

---
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@edgeai.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production rollout — burst behavior & rate cap guidance

Samantha — thanks for the detail and the attachments. I reviewed the sample and the bursts are short but dense: ~15–30k tokens over 90s windows repeatedly.

We can offer a limited remediation plan that balances platform fairness and your rollout needs:
- Temporary prioritized window: 10:00–12:00 PT on rollout days (Tiered priority, not absolute reservation).
- Staggered burst uplift: 3x burst allowance for up to 6 contiguous minutes per hour, restricted to the rollout week.
- Automated throttling threshold: if one client exceeds 5x historical median during the window, automated fallback to a compatible lower-throughput model will apply.

Operational notes: we need a signed addendum to the contract for the uplift window (limits, metrics, and rollback triggers), and we will apply a 20% usage surcharge for the uplift time to offset capacity commitments. I can draft the addendum and the internal capacity allocation request once I have approval from Commercial.

Cc'ing Lauren to coordinate billing and Monica for the capacity schedule.

—Marcus Lin\Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

---
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: EdgeAI temporary ratecap remediation request (rollout week)

Monica / Lauren —
EdgeAI (DEAL-43821) is requesting either a prioritized window or temporary burst uplift during their week-of-rollout (target start: 2027-05-10). Client sent traffic samples showing repeated short spikes. Proposed terms: 10:00–12:00 PT prioritized window + 3x burst for up to 6 mins/hr for 5 business days. Surcharge: 20% on tokens consumed during uplift windows.

Questions for approval:
- Monica: can we make an exception in the fairness policy for a named customer for a limited window? Any precedent?
- Lauren: can Billing prepare a one-off surcharge line item and DocuSign addendum?
- Ops: can we ensure capacity reservations for the uplift window if we commit (I will loop infra separately)?

Attachments: edgeai_sla_matrix.xlsx, redwood_traffic_sample.log

Thanks,
Marcus

---
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: EdgeAI temporary ratecap remediation request (rollout week)

Marcus —
We have precedent for short, named-customer priority windows for onboarding with charged uplift. Approve in principle with the following constraints:
- Window capped to two consecutive weekdays for the initial trial (we should not open a five-day straight exception without postmortem).
- Include explicit rollback triggers: sustained 429s across >3 other customers in the region or single-client 10x median sustained >15 minutes.
- Require telemetry dashboard shared with customer; if they can't provide it, no uplift.

Lauren — please draft the addendum and include a refundable credit clause if platform SLA is violated during our uplift (limit our risk).

Monica Patel\Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

---
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@edgeai.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production rollout — burst behavior & rate cap guidance

Samantha — thanks for raising this and for the samples. Per our internal review we can offer a limited remediation as follows:

Confirmed plan (trial):
- Two-day prioritized window: 10:00–12:00 PT on 2027-05-11 and 2027-05-12. During those windows EdgeAI traffic will receive elevated priority relative to general fairness policies.
- Staggered burst uplift: up to 3x normal burst allowance for up to 6 continuous minutes per hour during the trial windows.
- Surcharge: 20% added to token consumption during uplift windows (one-off invoice line).
- Conditions: EdgeAI must enable request smoothing within 7 days and provide live telemetry feeds to our SRE dashboard. If any rollback triggers fire we will end the trial immediately and revert to standard fairness rules.

Next steps:
1) Marcus will send the addendum for signature via DocuSign (we'll attach metrics and rollback triggers).
2) EdgeAI to confirm acceptance and share telemetry endpoint by EOD 2027-05-06.
3) We will provision a temporary capacity reservation and monitor closely; post-trial we'll run a joint postmortem and decide whether to expand.

Samantha, please reply-all to confirm you accept the terms. Marcus and I will coordinate the DocuSign.

Best,
Lauren Bishop\Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
attachments: edgeai_sla_matrix.xlsx
